ideas.title: Shard Armada
ideas.growth: scout -> five-ship wing -> thirteen-ship armada; broader weapons and larger enemy citadels
ideas.depth: support shield dependencies plus alternating volley polarity change efficient target order
ideas.reason: Direct, visible attack response and power growth; bounded state does not require automatic movement or a shallow toggle board.

ideas.title: Forge Tides
ideas.growth: small foundry expands weapons and fortifications
ideas.reason: Explaining reserve conversion and simultaneous front pressure risks crowding the first mobile viewport.

ideas.title: Bloom Colossus
ideas.growth: small creature absorbs limbs and changes reach
ideas.reason: Continuous collision/body configurations would not fit the reviewed v1 finite-state structure without hiding important behavior.
